jobs.description:
Are you an experienced roller operator with a passion for asphalt works?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced roller operator for our asphalt works.

What does your job involve?

• You independently operate the road roller during asphalt works.
• You ensure the correct and even compaction of the asphalt according to the required quality standards.
• You take into account the temperature and composition of the asphalt and adapt your working method accordingly.
• You work closely with machine operators, drivers and other colleagues in the asphalt crew.
• You help monitor the quality of the road surface and ensure that the works are carried out accurately.
• You work with modern machines, techniques and tools.
• You carry out daily checks and help ensure the proper maintenance of the machine.
• You depart daily from the depot in Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

• You have experience as a road roller operator, preferably in asphalt or road construction.
• You have a good understanding of asphalt compaction and understand the importance of using the correct rolling technique.
• You have good technical insight and can work confidently with modern machinery.
• You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions.
• You speak fluent Dutch or English.
• You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

• You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
• You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
• You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
• You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.
 

What do we expect from you?

• You have a valid Category C driving licence.
• Code 95 is NOT required.
• You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
• You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.
Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Organisation

Inetum Consulting is a strategy and transformation consulting firm part of the Inetum group. With a team of 450 multidisciplinary consultants, we are present in Europe (France, Spain, Portugal, Belgium) and Africa (Morocco).

Inetum Consulting supports companies and public organizations in their strategic projects through five major offerings: CIO Advisory, Sustainability, Data & GenAI, Transformation & Change, Corporate Functions Advisory.

Guided by a sector-specific consulting approach enriched by innovation and technological solutions, we help our customers steer their transformation towards sustainable performance and a more resilient, responsible society.

We value a unique and strong corporate culture, imbued with the values of excellence, which contributes significantly to the success of organizations.

At inetum consulting, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job description

To support the growth of Inetum Consulting in Belgium, we are hiring a Business Analyst to reinforce our teams delivering transformation projects in the following ecosystems: Energy & Utilities, Supply Chain & Manufacturing, Public, and Healthcare. You will contribute to both client missions and internal initiatives that accelerate the growth of our consulting unit and strengthen our sector offerings.

We are looking for someone with a proven track record in delivering mid-to-large scale digital and transformation projects, who takes ownership, is eager to learn, and thrives in an environment that combines client impact with entrepreneurial team growth.

Your responsibilities

 
• You will lead and deliver consulting assignments, including:
  
   
• Data analysis, benchmarks, stakeholder interviews, and insight synthesis
   
• Workshop facilitation and workshop animation with client stakeholders
   
• Process mapping, business analysis, and definition of implementation roadmaps
   
• Supporting (or leading) project workstreams as part of major digital transformation programs
    
  
 
• You will contribute to a broad range of transformation topics, such as:
  
   
• Projects to improve operational performance
   
• Strategic framing and optimization of business processes
   
• Master plan definition and implementation...
  
...

• Master's degree (engineering or business school)

• Minimum 2 years of professional experience, including previous experience in a consulting firm (strategy, transformation, operations excellence, or digital consulting)

• Have experience in process modelling (BPMN)

• Demonstrated experience delivering cross-functional improvement or transformation projects

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to manage project teams and engage senior client stakeholders

• Interest in ERP tools or other sector related technologies is considered a plus

• Fluent in English and fluent in either Dutch or French with professional working proficiency in the other language

• Entrepreneurial mindset and motivation to collaborate and grow within the Inetum Consulting team

Job description

Are you an experienced Sales professional who thrives on engaging with the business profiles of clients, C-Level, not just IT? Do you have the drive to not only expand existing customers but also focus on business development and acquiring new logos? Then we are looking for you!

As a Senior Account Manager you will primarily focus on the Industry sector, operating as a true Trusted Advisor for your customers. You will listen to their needs, analyze them, and co-create customized and innovative solutions. Your strength lies in your technology-independent approach. Thanks to our leading technology stacks, you will be able to offer the most specialized solutions. You will also leverage your extensive network to efficiently engage resources.

In this role, you will have a clear purpose: to further grow your customer and prospect portfolio with our solutions and build stable long-term relationships, becoming their partner.

Your role will focus on business development, where you actively identify opportunities, convert leads into long-term collaborations, and create added value for both your customers and the company.

You will be responsible for

 
• Proactively identify and chase new business opportunities within your customer portfolio and prospects.
 
• Build and cultivate strong relationships with prospects and existing customers to foster loyalty and trust.
 
• Keenly follow up on your customers' businesses, understand the trends that impact them, and stay aware of the competitive landscape.
 
• Stay ahead of the curve with the latest technological trends and possibilities, translating these into relevant and inspiring solutions for your customers.

Additional information

Discover your future with inetum belgium

 
• Make a Difference with a Meaningful Career: step into a role where your work truly matters. At Inetum Belgium, you'll have the chance to impact lives and drive meaningful change every day.
 
• Grow and Evolve Professionally: embrace a culture of continuous learning and development. We offer a range of training opportunities designed to help you expand your skills and advance your career.
 
• Unlock Relevant Career Opportunities: pursue the career path you've always dreamed of with tailored opportunities and the IT expertise you need to succeed.
 
• Achieve Work-Life Balance: we value your well-being. Enjoy flexible working hours, the convenience of satellite offices, the comfort of home working, and an informal, no-nonsense environment.
 
• Enjoy...
...

• You thrive on selling solutions & services.

• You are passionate about following the latest trends and translating them into relevant and inspiring solutions for your customers and prospects.

• You use all your Sales and networking skills to get top-of-mind at your customers and target audience.

• You have strong communication and presentation skills.

• You ensure predictability and accuracy in pipeline management.

• You are a team player and orchestrator, able to work closely with our Business Units to support and deliver services by onboarding and engaging them on due time.

• You are open to work in an international environment, even if your Sales area will be Belgium.

• You are fluent in Dutch and English, with base in French being a plus.

• Having an existing network in the Private Sector (Industry) is considered a significant plus.
